tweets.text:
Today—after 1,569 days in the @Amplitude_HQ  saddle—my time aboard the rocket ship is coming to an end. What a ride; what a team.

Way back in 2018, @sandhya, Matt Althauser, @justinjbauer  and @spenserskates  took a gamble on the "feature factory guy".

1/n

Normally, product evangelists talk about "the product".

My style was to talk about the world surrounding the product—product strategy, data culture, data-informed roadmaps, asking better questions, being "product-led", situational awareness, etc.

2/n

They supported me in that approach, and for that I will be forever grateful. It is a real testament to the company's mission and philosophy.

I never had to worry about the product (amazing), or our incredible customer success, PS, SE, legal teams. All amazing.

3/n

I just focused on helping companies along their journey. What an opportunity.

To all the current (and future) customers I had the honor of helping: thank you! It means so much that you trusted @Amplitude_HQ (and me) to be a trusted partner.

4/n

Every day was like a mini product MBA.

I've lost count of how many conference talks, workshops, and 1:1 chats I've done (it's in the 1000s), but showing up to hear your stories and help you however I could made every day worthwhile.

Thank you.

5/end
